features.description: Persist and bank pi cloud sessions
acceptance_criteria: Cloud args use a generated UUID with --session-dir and --session-id; local/eval args retain --no-session.
Suffix match precedes newest-file fallback in the task-scoped directory; missing files do not invent a path.
Completed and failed post-launch results preserve existing ProviderData and bank pi_session_jsonl when available.
features.notes: Pi provider suite and cloud argv/result banking tests pass. Shared nativesession companion centralizes lookup for all providers; no .ail changes. Cloud sync skipped:no-task-id on actual branch coordinator/task-53b8873a; preserve current branch.

features.description: Bank Codex and Claude native session paths
acceptance_criteria: Codex matches session UUID in rollout filenames before newest fallback under isolated CODEX_HOME/sessions.
Claude resolves the actual session ID under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or the default ~/.claude/projects.
All post-launch return paths with results bank native paths without dropping existing ProviderData; fixtures cover match, fallback and missing files.
features.notes: Claude/Codex banking tests pass, covering successful and failed results, preserved ProviderData and missing files. Named-return defers cover all result branches. Shared lookup fixtures cover identity preference and isolated newest fallback. Baseline b7b7093e independently reproduces both Codex process-group cancellation failures.

features.description: Resolve and copy provider sessions in cloud artifacts
acceptance_criteria: writeTaskArtifacts takes the canonical provider name and its call sites compile.

ProviderData is primary; failed or empty candidates permit provider-specific fallback; Claude searches bucket, config and default roots, pi its task dir, Codex its isolated home, motoko its banked path.
Native bytes are copied unchanged with os.WriteFile to tasks/{taskID}/session.jsonl, with no size cap.
Reads retry up to three total attempts at two-second intervals; success emits the exact written byte-count log, exhausted failure names provider, session and searched paths.
Deterministic-bump skips session handling; nil result and transcript behavior remain valid.
features.notes: Focused cmd/ailang native-session and Claude setup fixtures pass. Shared lookup resolves symlink roots; ProviderData precedes provider fallbacks; retries are bounded at three total attempts, two seconds apart. Copy uses os.WriteFile and reports exact bytes or searched paths. Nil/deterministic runs are covered. Follow-up fixes Claude resume/reported identity and home lookup error handling.

features.description: Verify artifact landing and metrics for every provider
acceptance_criteria: Fixture tests for claude, pi, codex and motoko each assert byte-identical session.jsonl at the task artifact destination.
metrics.json includes session_provider and session_jsonl_bytes matching the successful copy; missing sessions report zero bytes.
Tests capture success and warning output, including searched paths, unreadable/empty files, retry exhaustion, write failure and deterministic-bump silence.
A payload larger than the existing log truncation threshold retains full tool-result content; unrelated transcript and metrics fields survive.

features.description: Run focused gates and document cloud canaries
acceptance_criteria: make test-changed, make check-file-sizes, make check-changelog and make lint pass; make check-boundaries verifies touched imports.
Plan documents post-merge canaries for pi, codex, claude and motoko plus pi-go/codex-go routing verification, with task IDs, artifact byte counts and log evidence recorded when executed.
No live deployment or canary is claimed by offline tests; blocked cloud access is recorded as pending operational validation.
